results.title: Frontend Developer - React.js/TypeScript/Next.js
results.description:
**Job Description :**

We are hiring Front-End Engineers to build the surfaces where AI outputs meet real usersstreaming chat, dense dashboards, multi-view visualizations, and the interaction patterns that make non-deterministic systems feel trustworthy.

You are not implementing fixed designs.

You are co-shaping how people actually interact with what AI producesacross audiences with different mental models on the same product.

You partner closely with product, design, and engineering to translate ambiguous ideas into interfaces that ship.

You treat AI as the substrate of how software gets builtnot a tool to be cautious of, not something you are "exploring," but the medium you work in.

You work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, and modern AI-assisted development workflows

**What You'll Do :**

**Shape the surface :**

\- Sit with product, design, and engineering to translate evolving requirements and ambiguous ideas into shipping interfaces.

\- Co-shape interaction patterns for AI-driven experiencesstreaming responses, evidence citations, confidence cues, guided workflowsas UX is stress-tested with real users.

\- Build prototypes fast to react to. Iterate from rough designs and feedback rather than waiting for finished specs.

\- Distinguish AI-surfaced output from authoritative or human-approved content visually and structurallybecause in enterprise contexts that distinction matters.

**Build (fast) with AI :**

\- Build production-grade front-ends in React 18+ with TypeScript, using Next.js (App Router) or equivalent meta-frameworks (Remix, TanStack Start).

\- Implement streaming UI patterns for chat interfaces and agent interactionsServer-Sent Events, streaming fetch, optimistic updates, partial rendering.

\- Build dense, real-time dashboards with multi-level drill-down (portfolio / segment / entity / task) and multi-view visualizations.

\- Implement data visualizations using Recharts, Visx, D3.js, Plotly, or EChartsincluding radar/spider charts, time-series, and custom chart compositions.

\- Build component architectures grounded in design systems and tokens, using Tailwind CSS with shadcn/ui, Radix UI, Material UI, or Mantine.

\- Implement client and server state cleanly : TanStack Query for server state; Zustand, Redux Toolkit, or Jotai for client state.

\- Use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) through structured workflows, templates, and sub-agentswith discipline and review.

**Ship, Operate, Harden :**

\- Own role-based access at the UI layer, integrate with enterprise SSO (Okta, Auth0, Entra ID, or equivalent) using the appropriate SDK.

\- Implement forms with React Hook Form + Zod (or equivalent schema validation) for type-safe data flow end-to-end.

\- Write tests that hold up : Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright for E2E.

\- Build to WCAG 2.1 AA conformance : keyboard navigation, ARIA patterns, accessible colour and contrast, screen reader support.

\- Deploy on AWS (or Cloudflare for edge use cases)chosen for fit.

\- Apply engineering practices that hold up in production : structured logging, observability, performance budgets, automated CI/CD (GitHub Actions).

\- Own what you build end-to-end, including how it behaves in production.

**What You Bring :**

\- 3+ years modern front-end engineering experience, production-grade.

\- Strong React 18+ and TypeScript fundamentals, with hands-on Next.js (App Router) or equivalent meta-framework experience.

\- Data visualization experience : radar/spider charts, multi-level drill-down dashboards, real-time data views. Hands-on with at least one of Recharts, Visx, D3.js, Plotly, or ECharts.

\- Streaming UI experience : Server-Sent Events, streaming fetch, real-time data patterns, chat-style interfaces with progressive rendering.

\- Component architecture and design-system implementation. Hands-on with Tailwind CSS and at least one component library (shadcn/ui, Radix UI, Material UI, or Mantine).

\- Strong state management with TanStack Query plus one of Zustand, Redux Toolkit, or Jotai.

\- Forms and validation : React Hook Form + Zod or equivalent.

\- Testing discipline : Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright (or equivalent) for E2E.

\- WCAG 2.1 AA conformance, keyboard navigation, ARIA patterns.

\- Active, structured use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows.

\- Comfortable iterating from evolving designs and co-shaping interaction patterns rather than executing fixed specs.

\- Strong attention to information hierarchyyou can hold multiple audiences with different mental models in your head on the same product.

\- A real, recent trail of built things : GitHub, a portfolio, side projects, indie tools, or OSS contributions.

\- A no-compromise attitude on clean code, performance, accessibility, and user experience.

\- Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Design Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent demonstrable experience).

**Bonus Skills / Experience :**

\- Experience building front-ends for LLM-powered products : streaming chat UIs, evidence citation surfaces, agent interaction patterns.

\- Design tokens and design-system implementation experience at scale.

\- Storybook for component documentation.

\- Real-time data patterns : WebSockets, server-driven UI, optimistic updates.

\- Authentication flows with enterprise SSO providers (Okta, Auth0, Entra ID, or equivalent).

\- Healthcare or life sciences domain exposure.

\- Public writing, talks, or threads about building with AI

results.title: Senior Frontend Developer - React.js/Next.js/TypeScript
results.description:
**Role Overview:**

Our Client is seeking an experienced Senior Frontend Developer to lead the design, build, and evolution of React and Next.js applications for an enterprise-scale, serverless platform on AWS supporting national-level digital infrastructure.

You will own the frontend across the full software development lifecycle, from UI architecture and design-system work through development, deployment, and production support. You will work closely with architects, designers, backend engineers, and delivery leads to ship scalable, accessible, high-performance user experiences, while setting standards and mentoring other frontend engineers.

**Key Responsibilities:**

\- Lead the architecture, design, and development of responsive, accessible web applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.

\- Build performant Next.js applications using the App Router, React Server Components, SSR, SSG, and ISR.

\- Design and maintain a reusable component library and design system in partnership with UX/UI designers.

\- Define patterns for state management, routing, data fetching, caching, and error handling.

\- Integrate frontends with RESTful APIs and serverless backend services, collaborating with backend engineers on API contracts.

\- Own frontend performance, monitoring Core Web Vitals and optimizing bundle size, rendering, and load times.

\- Ensure WCAG accessibility compliance across all user-facing features.

\- Establish and enforce frontend engineering standards through code reviews, automated testing, and linting.

\- Contribute to frontend build, CI/CD, and deployment pipelines on AWS.

\- Support production releases, monitoring, and troubleshooting of frontend issues.

\- Provide technical leadership and mentorship to frontend developers.

\- Leverage AI tools to improve developer productivity, code quality, and UI testing.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

\- Languages: expert-level TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6+).

\- React: hooks and functional components, advanced component patterns, state management (Redux Toolkit, React Query/TanStack Query, or Context API), and React Router.

\- Next.js: App Router, React Server Components, SSR/SSG/ISR, route handlers and middleware, data fetching and caching, and SEO/performance optimization (Core Web Vitals).

\- Web fundamentals: semantic HTML5, CSS3, and modern styling (CSS Modules, Tailwind CSS, or styled-components); responsive design and WCAG 2.1/2.2 accessibility.

\- Tooling & testing: Vite or Webpack, npm/pnpm, ESLint/Prettier, Jest or Vitest, React Testing Library, and Cypress or Playwright.

\- Design systems: experience building and maintaining shared component libraries (e.g., Storybook).

\- Strong understanding of RESTful API design and integrating APIs with frontend applications.

\- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and frontend deployment automation.

\- Familiarity with frontend monitoring and logging (e.g., Amazon CloudWatch RUM, Amazon Managed Grafana, Sentry).

\- Proven track record of technical leadership, code review, and mentoring in a team setting.

**Nice-to-Have Skills:**

\- Familiarity with serverless backends (AWS Lambda, API Gateway) and authentication with Amazon Cognito.

\- Experience hosting Next.js on AWS (Amplify, OpenNext, or S3 + CloudFront) and AWS CDK in TypeScript.

\- Experience with micro-frontends or monorepo tooling (Nx, Turborepo).

\- Experience integrating AI/ML-powered features (e.g., Amazon Bedrock) into user interfaces.

\- Exposure to large-scale or government/national infrastructure systems.

\- Backend AWS work (SQS, Step Functions, EventBridge, SES, Glue).

**Job Description:**

# **Job Description: Frontend Engineer**

**Tech Stack: Next.js | React | TypeScript | Redux Toolkit | Tailwind CSS**

## **Role Overview**

We are looking for a Frontend Engineer with strong experience in React, Next.js, and TypeScript to build scalable, high-performance, and maintainable web applications. The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of frontend architecture, state management, API integration, and performance optimization, with the ability to collaborate effectively with backend engineers and other stakeholders.

## **Key Responsibilities**

- Develop scalable, responsive, and maintainable web applications using Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
- Build reusable UI components and follow established frontend architecture and coding standards.
- Manage application state using Redux Toolkit, including slices, reducers, selectors, and asynchronous thunks.
- Integrate REST APIs, work with API contracts, and handle asynchronous operations, errors, loading states, and data synchronization.
- Build responsive interfaces using Tailwind CSS and modern frontend development practices.
- Optimize application performance, rendering, bundle size, and data-fetching workflows.
- Implement form validation, routing, authentication flows, and permission-aware UI.
- Write testable, high-quality code and participate in code reviews, debugging, and technical discussions.
- Collaborate with backend engineers to define API requirements, troubleshoot integration issues, and deliver features end to end.

## **Required Skills**

**Core Technologies**

- Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
- Solid understanding of React hooks, component composition, reusable patterns, and modern Next.js architecture.
- Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, and Tailwind CSS.

**State Management and API Integration**

- Hands-on experience with Redux Toolkit, including slices, selectors, and createAsyncThunk.
- Experience integrating REST APIs and working with API contracts, request/response schemas, and TypeScript types.
- Understanding of HTTP methods, status codes, authentication, pagination, filtering, and error handling.
- Ability to manage asynchronous workflows, loading states, failed requests, and data consistency.

**Performance and Advanced Frontend Concepts**

- Understanding of React rendering, re-renders, memoization, and component optimization.
- Experience with code splitting, lazy loading, caching, and bundle optimization.
- Understanding of Next.js rendering strategies, including SSR, SSG, Server Components, Client Components, and data-fetching patterns.
- Familiarity with browser developer tools, performance profiling, and Core Web Vitals.

**Engineering Practices**

- Proficiency with Git, branching, pull requests, and collaborative development workflows.
- Familiarity with frontend testing using tools such as Jest/Vitest and React Testing Library.
